description.value:
Transcendent · Withdrawn, Not Dead

Watched what humanity did to itself and to Uriel, and simply left. Heaven's gates locked; Hell stopped taking calls too. Not divine death — a deliberate absence, which means the door is not necessarily closed forever. Vigil is the class built entirely around this: patient, rare, slow to act on any individual scale, aimed at maybe someday earning that attention back.
